text: The Old Man of the Woods is a Gangrel who has become a draugr. He is a careful predator.
The Other (also known by such names as Pandora, Atum, Marduk, and the Old One) is the Aeon who represents the Abyss.

Oskar Anasov is a Nosferatu and the Herald of London. Originally, a refugee from the , he is a superb orator and agitator, issuing announcements by the Court and also working with graffiti artists to incorporate hidden signs into London's streets.
Olivia Fairchild is a twelfth generation Tremere and the sire of the occultist Clarence Bartleby. She embraced Clarence when he broke into her warded house to steal a forbidden book.
Osobei Vasilevitch was a Tzimisce emissary of the Voivodate assigned to negotiate with the Livonian Ferals, after their leader Qarakh diablerized the powerful Ventrue Alexander.
Brigadier General Oscar Martin is a Iteration X mage and member of the Advanced Energy Commission Construct in Las Vegas.
Oliver Prudhomme is a Kindred. He informed the Giovanni about the whereabouts of Cappadocian survivors.
The Oneira or Dream Lords are mysterious entities from the Dream Zone.

The Pasiphae, so-called Ferrymen of Oblivion or Walkers of the Labyrinth, are often mistaken to be the generals of the Shadow-eaten by ignorant Helldivers and the few other foolhardy wraiths that venture into the Labyrinth. A classification of that kind does them a great injustice however - their allegiance lies not with the denizens of the Labyrinth, yet in some ways they are closer to the nature of it than any Malfean.
Painter is a homid Ahroun Black Fury. She a member of a pack of Freebooters who joined Caern Mammoth in Appalachia.
.]] The Patriarch is, according the Black Furies, the Incarna of jealous men, and a servant of Abhorra, the Urge Wyrm of hatred. It is also one of the three Weaver Incarna
Owain ap Ieuan, also known as Owain Evans, is an elder of the Ventrue antitribu who managed to overcome the supernatural disease known as the "Blood Curse".
Ove Waldemar is one of the Possessed, a mortal who has been made the host of a demon.
Pashdaniel is a Fiend in Los Angeles. Pashdaniel is possessing a mortal known as Mandrake.
Panatei is a Devourer. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as Tyson McDowell.
In the Classic World of Darkness, Pattern Spiders are the most basic kind of spider-shaped spirits working for the Weaver.

Pherydima is a Kiasyd known for a dissertation on the true names of Abyssal entities, which was stolen a month before the fifth Great Symposium of . As a result of the theft, thought to have been conducted by a fellow Kiasyd, the bloodline canceled all further symposia for a century and Béatrice L'Angou promised five decades of mentorship and free access to her library to whoever found the culprit. In VTES (which is non-canon), she is also a bishop of the Sabbat.

Philandros was the harbormaster of Rhodes during the time of the Web of Seven. Barred from the navy by a club foot, he nonetheless did what he could to aid it. A superstitious man, he utilized a ritual that called for his crutch and the blood of a chicken. Any time he failed to perform the ritual, disaster struck the unsanctified ship.
Percival of Ghent is a Gangrel soldier of the Knights of Avalon. Originally from Ghent in the county of Flanders, he heard of the Order's work and crossed the sea to offer them his sword.

Peter the Abbot is an elder vampire of the Dark Ages, with particular talent for cohabitating with humans and pull within the Church, as well as having an incredible occult library and access to the secrets within.
Pralix was a Tytalan mage who, in the ninth century, founded House Ex Miscellanea.
The Prince of Shadows is a Daybreak caste Abyssal Exalt in service to the Lover Clad in the Raiment of Tears.
Professor Infinity is a Mastigos Seer of the Throne (Mysterium) from Chicago
The Prince of Eboracum was a Ventrue methuselah and the ruler of York in ancient times. He was beheaded by his childe Julian Cerialis who took over rulership of his domain.

The Progenitor Wolf, First Wolf, Wolf, White Wolf (by the Silver Fangs), Ancestor or Tracks-in-Fresh-Snow is considered the first of the Garou. And is often discussed about as a legendary or mythic character.
Preston Varrick is a Tremere and the current Regent of Tokyo.
Qarakh the Untamed was a Gangrel warlord and signature character of his clan during the Dark Ages. Among others, he diablerized the Ventrue methuselah Alexander of Paris.
Prospero is the pseudonym of an enigmatic vampire who makes his haven on the Cayman Islands. His actual lineage and generation are unknown.
Quistamalla, born as Tamara Arouet, is a Homid Ananasi fortune-teller of some renown among her kind.
Pseulak, called the Minister of Deception and Lul-Rihur, is one of the nine Maeljin who rule the dark parts of the Shadow.
R. J. is a tenth generation Gangrel and member of the Union Council of Cleveland.
Qufur am-Heru I was a Fourth Generation Setite Hierophant and the childe of Set.

Rabark the Inhabited is a Neverborn Malfean featured in both Wraith: The Oblivion and Orpheus. She appears to represent gluttony or sloth. She takes her title from her form, though this has changed over time. Originally she was composed of spongy, rotten wood that infested the Labyrinth with roots that reached into the Tempest. Her "trunk" had hollows where her followers and lackeys could take shelter. By Orpheus, her body, surmounted by a grotesquely large head, is a mass of flesh resembling nothing more than a 1,000 foot-high wall of fat stuffed into a thin sallow sack of skin. Her worshippers, many powerful Spectres, actually live inside of her fat, burrowing tunnels and burning the greas

Rabbat, sometimes calling herself Cloacina, is a Nosferatu elder with the dubious honor of having transferred the Black Death into the realm of the Kindred. She occupied the 12th place on the Red List and was recently evaluated to the 13th.
Rafaela Lapaz was a 9th generation Tzimisce resident of Mexico City.

Rachel Evans was an 11th generation Toreador resident of Washington, D.C.. She has short red hair, soft blue eyes and a slender build. She’s about 5’6” and usually wears jeans, a T-shirt and a leather jacket. When she’s visiting Elysium, she takes time to put on a fashionable dress and lots of makeup.
: See also Ravenna (disambiguation) Ravenna, born Iris DuMont, is a 9th generation Follower of Set and the high priestess of the Setite temple of Washington D.C.
Rachel is an eighth-generation Gangrel from the Denver area.
Rachel Hrafn is a horror who was brought back to life to avenge herself on her killers.
Raindancer is a Stargazer Theurge who appears in both versions of Rage.
Rage-in-the-Streets is a Red Talon Ahroun from Australia. He has assumed the role of Sept Leader after Mamu's disappearance.

Genevieve of London, better known as Ragged Jenny is a Nosferatu criminal mastermind and the former ruler of London's underground. In the dark ages, she dominated the underworld of London and operated a school for mortal and Cainite footpads. She was seen as little more than a petty criminal by the Nosferatu Richard de Worde, but her influence then rivaled his own and extended across Europe.
Razor is a Brujah Autarch of London, and a popular hitman in East London.
Red Wolf is a master of adaptation and cousin to Coyote, the trickster. Totem of the Iron Masters. Red Wolf’s vow is, “Honor your territory in all things.”
Reesie Thompson is a man who gained the ability to see beyond the Mask when he was shot at eight.

Reverend Billy Carr is a Spirit-Claimed Human who leads the Church of the Asphalt Angels in the Mojave Desert. The spirits of the Church once served the idigam, Uzuthil, that has been now destroyed by the Forsaken.
A Relict Man (also known as a Wild Man or a Jack of the Wood) is a type of spirit taking the form of man.
Rex Mundi is a Iron Master Cahalith member of the Lodge of Wires.
Terrence Coleman is a reverend who leads the protests at the Succubus Club. He is gifted with true faith, and his presence is essential to the story.
Resheph is a Scourge in Los Angeles. Resheph is possessing the body of a mortal known as Friedrich Mace.
Reynier is a tenth generation Brujah Anarch in the Fief of the North.
A Rebis is a single being with a single mind created by a Qashmallim via Teiersian Metamorphosis.
Renate Jakobs is a Nosferatu of the Frankfurt Rhine-Main Camarilla.

The Rock Lord is the name given to the semi-legendary Gargoyle who escaped when its master was killed in a Tzimisce attack. It began to live deep in the Carpathian Mountains, where it bred its own brood of independent childer. The Tremere wonder about the identity of this "Rock Lord", and many believe it to be Chaundice, the first Gargoyle ever created. However, it should be noted that one named Ferox is also called "Rock Lord" by his fellows Gargoyles.
used in ritual|359x359px]] The Ritual of Sacred Rebirth is a mystic ritual known to be capable of turning Kinfolk into full werewolves. Garou created in this way are known as Skin Dancers.
Righteous Endeavor, born Righteous Endeavor Clay, is a Tzimisce pack priest, witch hunter, and Priscus of the Sabbat.
Rico Loco is a 13th generation Ventrue antitribu of the Black Hand.
Riel is an Unseelie Sluagh Wilder in the Kingdom of Willows.
The Rogue Sister, also called Tanglewoman, Lady Treachery, the Fourth Goddess, and Hecate, is a Morphean associated with the breaking of fate, including pledges.
The Rider in Shameful Dreams is an akathartos that represents sexual repression. It is known to haunt the dreams of those it enters.
Robert "Jagged Sky" Fiero is a Iron Master Elodoth alpha of the Jagged Sky's Pack in Colorado.
Ritchie Whelan is a Iron Masters Cahalith alpha of the Wednesday's Children Pack in Sheffield, UK.

Rolf Trask was a homicidal tenth generation Malkavian and the sire of Gary Stapleton. He kidnapped a mortal Gary and kept him in his thrall with his Dominate powers. He skinned his victim's face and Embraced him so Gary could heal his wounds and Rolf could repeat the skinning. A vampire Gary was able to break free of Domination and destroyed his sire with his own razor blade, taking the blade's name for himself.
Rolf Haubach is an eighth generation Nosferatu of the Frankfurt Rhine-Main Camarilla.
: For the character "Rosa" from Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines see Rosa (VTMB) Rosa is a Lasombra of the Sabbat, and the eldest childe of Rudesi.
Baroness Sabrina Lennin-Corvald is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Leanhaun and ruler of the Barony of Peachtree in the Kingdom of Willows.

The Ruinous Prince, known by such names as Father-Slayer, End of Empires, the Impure Gatekeeper, and Mordred, is known to changelings as a Morphean who represents power and the price of taking it; and to Mages as an Aeon representing the Arcanum of Fate.
S. K. Bhurano was the quantakinesis Proxy and founder of the Chitra Bhanu.
Sabine is a tenth generation Setite and the sire of Andreas Aegyptus.
Rune Batersmith is a Garou and claims to be the King of the American Children of Sarrath.
Rosemarie is a Daughter of Cacophony and a part of the Camarilla
Salvatore Ragonese is a 10th generation Anarch, a former professional wrestler with connections to organised crime, and one of the Kindred competing for the position of Baron of Pasadena.

The Scarlet Empress is the founder and sole ruler of the Realm. During the Great Contagion, it was she who braved the Imperial Manse and used its control of the Realm's ancient magical defenses to save Creation from the invading Fair Folk. She then crowned herself Empress of the Realm — using her control of the Realm defenses to crush all opposition, as well as an alliance with Chejop Kejak and the Sidereal Exalted — and proceeded to rule the world for the next 763 years. Her disappearance in RY 763 has upset the status quo of Creation, and the return of the Solar Exalted has only complicated the situation.

The Scarlet Queen, also known as the Scarlet Phoenix, is one of the Ministers of Creation, the ruler of the Yang World (though the history of the Hsien names the phoenixes as the masters of Yin). Her mate is the Ebon Dragon. Together they created the Wan Xian — the Ten Thousand Heroes — to protect the world in the name of the August Personage of Jade, and birthed numerous shen. In the modern era, the Scarlet Queen and Ebon Dragon are — according to Lucifer — the last remaining Angels on Earth. They are probably the "Messengers" responsible for creating the imbued, or at least the leaders of the factions championing the virtues of Zeal and Mercy. As the Scarlet Queen r
Scarlet Carson O'Toole is a City Gangrel of the San Francisco Sabbat.
Sangris the Serpent was the Archbishop of Montréal and an infamous infernalist.

Sarisel is an Earthbound Fiend known as the Gardener of Hell. Originally responsible for greenery before the War, Sarisel joined the rebellion under unclear circumstances that he later bemoaned. Resurfacing in Ancient China after the Fall, his cult consists of a cabal of wizards.
Sascha Rominoff is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Liam in the Kingdom of Apples.
Sara is a Wizened Smith living in the freehold of Miami. She has recently, along with her motley, been scouted by Blue Jenny to aid in her coup attempt.
Santayana is a Iron Master Cahalith member of the Jagged Sky's Pack in Colorado.
Scorylo Howls-Like-Ghosts is a Homid Philodox Children of Gaia during 31 BCE. Under the Rite of Undying Pursuit, Scorylo's spirit eternally chases after the Drowned King.

Samantha Drake is a 10th Generation Malkavian diablerist in New Orleans. She loathes her vampiric existence, so much so that she's dedicated her unlife to hunting for the vitae of the direct lineage who sired her, in the vain hope that it'll somehow turn her mortal again.

Sanderburg is the Brujah Prince of Honolulu and an expatriate from San Francisco. He ruled a small community of Kindred, that subsisted well enough on tourists and the occasional local, but was careful not to risk the tourism industry.
Sauvitar is a Devourer in Los Angeles. Sauvitar is possessing the body of the mortal known as Agent Marcus Keyes.
Sarah Jamison is a Verbena mage and member of the Big Springs Chantry in Las Vegas.
Sean O'Meara is a ninth generation Tremere and the Regent of Belfast.
Sandra Quattlebaum is a Hierarch wraith of the Emerald Legion.

Sarmis Le Voyageur is a Fifth Generation Ravnos methuselah. Little is known about Sarmis the Traveler, and he himself recounts many incredible tales of the journeys that led him all around the known world. Sarmis is a "living" library of the history of the known world, of its legends and of its traditions. He has lived through many conflicts, witnessed the conquests of Alexander the Great, the fall of Carthage and of Constantinople, and even, according to him, that of Troy. Sarmis is convinced that his perpetual quest for knowledge will lead him onto the path of Golconda, and that "to understand oneself is, above all, to understand others." Mostly removed from Cainite communities, he seeks a
Samira Rahmani is a homid Garou. A young Afghan refugee in Warsaw, Samira fled to Poland after the return to power of the Talibans in her country.
Sanaa is an Egyptian Follower of Set of unknown generation who participates in Ulwazi Mpande's gathering in Pretoria.

Sh'zar, also known as "The Seer" and "The Timeless", is the founder of the Cult of Ecstasy Tradition and one of its most influential members. He is said to exist outside of history, hence the nickname.
Sesheta was an Awakened mage active circa 2500 BCE. She, along with her husband Djhowtey, is considered one of the founders of the Order of Hermes.
Seif Raushan, or Sir Seif, is an Ojo Eshu Wilder from the Kingdom of Willows and the chosen champion of Caliburn in the search for High King David.

Serif, born Theodora, is an Anarch Ravnos who operates in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Bronx Bronx] borough of New York. She and her coterie have domain over the neighborhood of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Port_Morris,_Bronx Port Morris].

Selene Iliades is an eighth generation Nosferatu of Athens. When her sire Vole abandoned her summoned by the Beckoning, she went missing. She joined the Cult of Aristovoros and became one of the high-ranking members of the cult.

Sebastian is a Lasombra cainite and the childe and right-hand man of Archbishop Borges of Miami. He participated in the Siege of Atlanta and was elected as Bishop of the city in the aftermath, competing in local power with Bishop Julius Sutphen. Not long after, he was destroyed.
Shade Spiders are Banes and Wyrm creatures made out of amputated hands.
Sephidor is a Malefactor. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as Sam Ashbury.
Sekaye Leblanc is a Euthanatos mage of the Political Triage International Cabal.
Sekhemkare is a Fifth Generation Setite Eternal of Sothis and the steward of the Garden of Asps.
Serpent Father(s) are Banes that are responsible for the creation of Serpent Brothers.

Shroud-Rending is one of the Dark Arcanoi, and allows Spectres to see the Skinlands and the Quick through the Shroud. As Spectres are not gifted with Lifesight as wraiths are, Shroud-Rending provides them with the only way to see and spy on the living. However, Spectres cannot appear before the living with this art; to do so requires knowledge of Embody. Nihils tend to form in the places this art is used frequently.
Shadowfiends are a type of fomor created by Pentex in the late 1960s to deal with social dissidents.
Sharon Miller is a high school cheerleader in the process of becoming an Enticer Fomor.
Shimmerlings are thought to be hobgoblins formed of the fae-warped remnants of human souls, torn as they passed through the Hedge.
Sheila Devries, ("Brown Dwarf"), is a Void Engineer barabbi Mage and crewmember of the Anastasia X156-B58.
Sheila is an old Tremere who stole Francis Lambert's tomes regarding blood sorcery. She is the sire of Will.
Sigiurnoth is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Sigiurnoth is possessing the body of a mortal known as Tina Cotroneo.
Sheldon is a Mnemoi who gives his services to anyone who can pay.

The lord of the Grim Legion, victims of violence, the Smiling Lord is also Stygia's foremost traitor, having sold out his master to Yu Huang in exchange for a position of authority over the Western Dead.

Called Mr. Bonyhands to anything but his face, the Skeletal Lord is the most loyal of Charon's Deathlords. He's also totally insane, believing himself to be the literal embodiment of Pestilence from the Book of Revelation.

Called the underfolk by many, the sluagh (SLOO-ah) are often pariahs even among other fae. Though rumors persist of underground catacombs and mazelike lairs, many sluagh prefer crumbling Victorian mansions to dank sewers. Places dark and forgotten, often with a mushroom garden, attract them. Those who intrude into their inner sanctums often leave with nightmares. Just as they value secrets and mysteries, sluagh treasure their privacy, and do a great deal to foster reputations that discourage visitors.
Smoke Shintai is a Discipline that allows the Kuei-jin to manipulate smoke to cause a variety of effects.
Siranuthis was was one of the Shan'iatu and one of the heads of the deceived Akhem-Urtu Guild. He is also referred to as the Singer and his domain were the arts of vocal performances.
Slique is an Unseelie Redcap Wilder on the edges of fae society.
Sirius, the Dog Star, is a totem spirit of the Silent Striders.
Skaft, was a former god of Tools in the Long-lost Atlantean Pantheon .

Smallpox Griet is a Nosferatu antitribu and Sabbat Cardinal of the North Rhine-Westphalia area in Germany. She lived in the area near Aachen since the early Middle Ages until 1460, when she joined the Sabbat movement.
Sir Kingston is a Ventrue ancient awakened in modern London.

Solomon Grey is a Caitiff sired by Mistrina, a Ventrue who couldn't stand the sight of him. He developed a propensity for Necromancy, was temporarily adopted by the Giovanni, and began developing his own unique Discipline.

Silver Wolf is the totem spirit of the Ivory Claws. Obsessed with Purity, his ban prevents him from accepting a pledge of service and brotherhood from any werewolf who has served "Luna's weaklings". Only the Purest of the pure are granted his gifts of blood absolution.
A Souleater is a creature of the Umbra. They were the greatest enemies of the Tal’Mahe’Ra vampiric sect before 20th Anniversary Vampire book The Black Hand: A Guide to the Tal’Mahe’Ra.

Stafan Blood-Moon-Child was a Homid Get of Fenris Theurge, born in 235 C.E. under a red crescent moon, considered an ill omen. His forms all had blood red fur like the moon he was born under. He eventually proved to be a gifted and honorable Theurge, and after his death at the hands of a bitter and Wyrm-tainted Ragabash tribe-mate named Wards-The-Dead, he returned as a potent ancestor-spirit to aid his Sept of the Harrowing Sky.
The Songwraith is a type of hobgoblin that feeds on the emotional energy of its victims.
Stefan Ellis is a Iron Master Rahu member of the Lodge of Stones.
Stalking Wolf is a Pack Totem to the Red Knives Pack in Colorado.
Southpaw O'Donnell is a Ghost Wolf Irraka member of the Dog Boys pack in Chicago.
Sradish is a seventh generation Nosferatu and the childe of the Nictuku Rasalon.
St. Adelard is a prophet of Abaddon. He is a Hagiography of a Sinner-Saint for infernalists.
Squeek is a Spirit and Familiar to a Technocrat mage known as Michael R. Hanson.

Sulabik the Death-Maker is a Onceborn Malfean who is featured in Orpheus. He represents the concept and sin of wrath. One of the more powerful Onceborn, Sulabik is unusually charismatic for a Malfean, and has a cadre of loyal troops, including more Hekatonkhire than any other Malfean. It was his charisma that also turned many formerly-human Spectres against Grandmother, leading her to use only Spectres she creates directly from her own person (such as Sparagmoi), or ones whose will she can utterly destroy and use as puppets (such as Lawgivers). Sulabik's powers are limited by his form; while he is gigantic like the other Malfeans, he is skeletal and physically weak, perhaps because he makes
Sullivan Dane is a feared vampire hunter, and a serious candidate to occupy a place in the Red List as an anathema.
:For the changeling kith, see Succubus (CTL) Succubi are a form of Incubus that takes the form of an acquaintance to seduce their targets.
Sukhmet was a Setite Methuselah in Lebanon. He was diablerized by Marnius.
Stigghalf Bone-Breaker is a Homid Ragabash Get of Fenris Master of the Challenge of the Sept of the Blood Fist.
Sunrise-Heart is a Red Talon Galliard Sept Leader of the Sept of the First Rage.

Stephen is a Tremere Ghoul agent of the Dark Ages. He infiltrated the lands of Voivode Boleslav Volhyny for his masters, but was captured and brought to Castle Volhyny before its ruler. There he was presented to Boleslav's childer and he was soon tortured for information.
Stracharn is a powerful Bishop of the Toronto Sabbat. He commands the border packs at the edge of the city.
Sunshine (formerly Amy Coltraine) is a Kindred belonging to the Sabbat pack known as the Chalice of Osseous Delights.
Stephanie de Horacio Pisanob is a Giovanni vampire of the Pisanob bloodline operating in Haiti during the "The Dead Walk" events.
Sylvan-Ivanovich-Sylvan is a Homid Theurge Shadow Lord, born in the 1950s.
Tara Mitchell, aka Shadowpad, is a Homid Philodox Child of Gaia living in New York.
==Overview== A being that has been Marked by the Devil; someone in obvious league with demonic powers.
Tamara Andreevna is a Verbena Mage and part of Baba Yaga's Army of the Arcane.
Sylvia Ortiz is a vampire and a member of the Boston Camarilla. She serves as the bartender in the Tower's bar.
Tahapeneskedu is a Fiend in Los Angeles. Tahapeneskedu is possessing a mortal known as DJ Pepper C.
Tadarida is a Sabbat Ductus and a follower of the Path of Death and the Soul, leading her forces in the Gehenna War.
Swarna Jayani is an Errant Orphan Mage, a former Euthanatos.
Tamara Nayibé is an Archon of the Camarilla, active around 1999.
Sybren van Oosten is a Ventrue of the Camarilla and the Prince of Rotterdam.
Terrence DeBouville was a Tzimisce of Montréal, servant of the demon Metathiax.

Terrible Teeth is the blessing of the Gristlegrinders. The changelings blessed with it has huge and sharp teeth in his terrible jaws: the character’s bite is a two lethal attack, though it does require him to grapple the opponent first.
Tepet Ejava, also called the Roseblack, is a Dragon-Blooded general and one of those vying for the throne of the Realm in the absence of the Scarlet Empress. She is the signature Wood Aspect.
The Cat is a manifestation of all cat-dreams, be they by cats or about them.
Tharmas was a Lasombra and the main enforcer of the Autarkis Vritra, the self-proclaimed "Queen of the Hudson" in New York City. He is destroyed by Reynard Cassel's ghoul hound.

The Rose, born Alison Benson, is a 9th generation Tzimisce luminary of the Path of Cathari among the Montréal Sabbat. Until an incident with a forged copy of the Shroud of Kaymakli in 2000, The Rose was ductus of the Widows pack. At some point after this incident but before 2003, Creamy Jade became packleader.

The Kailindorani changes into Crinos as she is about to throw an opponent, adding the foothold and force of the battle-form to her action. The opponent is thrown two meters per success + the Kailindorani’s Strength rating. The damage is usually Strength + successes, but depending on what the opponent lands on, may be more or less, at the Storyteller’s discretion. *Usable by: All except Crinos *Roll: Dexterity + Kailindo *Difficulty: 7 *Damage: Special *Actions: 1

The Horror Within is the Endowment of the Hunter conspiracy Survivors Club. Every hunter recognizes that the Vigil sometimes requires monstrous acts, but Survivors embrace the monstrous parts of themselves more intently than many of their Code-following counterparts. This embrace of the scourges that made them, or the hundreds of little ways they distance themselves from the rest of humanity, allows them to unlock powers their enemies rely upon. The hunter undergoes a ritual to contact with their inner monster. Once they learn this techniques, there is no turning back and will keep them even if they leave the conspiracy.
The Organist was a Tzimisce fleshcrafter who first created the Corpse Balloons. He met Final Death when faced by the mage Jack Robat.

Theodore Albert Walters is one of the Project Flatline subjects who vanished from Marion Federal Penitentiary, becoming one of the Flatliners. Unlike many of the Flatliners, Walters struck it out on his own. In prison for rape and on death row for murder, he resumed his old habits when he escaped, albeit with a sinister twist. He will Skinride friends of his victims, force them to a secluded spot, and rape them; he will also possess the woman and force her to assault herself. The Orpheus Group was never asked to investigate Walters because they wanted to keep the Project Flatline Fiasco a secret from their fellow employees. It is only after the Orpheus Group is destroyed by NextWorld that th
Therimna, known as Ute Kovacs in modern nights, was one of the first Tremere and one of the developers of Thaumaturgical Alchemy. She is an apostate of her Clan and acts as a mercenary.

Three Paws is a Red Talon Lupus of Minnesota. She is the mother of Blood Eye, who she gave birth to in 1957. In 1958, he prematurely developed his Garou abilities, dominating the pack and challenging Three Paws for dominance. Three Paws was barely able to defeat him.
Theora Hetirck is an infamous Euthanatoi mage and the Herald of Senex.
The Thorn Prince is a True Fae known for taking Ogre changelings.
The Witch is an antagonist in Hunter: The Reckoning - Wayward and is one of the Nephandi cultists that came to Ashcroft along with the Nephwrack.

The thoughtful scorpions were a particular brood of bark scorpions attached to the skull rack beside the Great Temple of the Aztec Empire. Capable of consuming the memories and knowledge of humans they kill (though they understand little of what they take, and only rarely engage in a human hunt), these scorpions form their own societies, with their own languages and gods. Much like the humans with whom they cohabitate, the thoughtful scorpions have turned to conquest over their fellows. Angels and cultists can consume thoughtful scorpions to gain the knowledge they have taken.

Theophilus is a seventh generation Brujah elder and lawmaker of Constantinople. He is the childe of the powerful Tribonius and along with his blood-brother Dorotheus, served as rival to Natalya Svyatoslav.
Thibault d'Armagnac is a Gangrel monster hunter and storyteller of the Medieval period.
Major Thomas Houston is a Void Engineer mage and member of the Advanced Energy Commission Construct in Las Vegas.
Tina Clear-Skull is a Metis Ragabash of the Silent Strider. She appears in Rage. Her Metis condition is her transparent skin.
Tiao Jin, the General of Fire is a Spirit-Ridden Human possessed by Kusa-Ihi from China, 188 AD.
Tony Castelli is a Brujah Herald of the Sun, a vessel of Mithras's will.
Tina Spencer is a Wraith. Quote: I was here in life. I'll stay here in death. If you want me to go, you're gonna have to make me.
Tock is a tenth generation Nosferatu antitribu and a drug kingpin within the Atlanta Sabbat. He sought to monopolize the Giovanni drug trade after the Sabbat conquered Atlanta in 1999.

Tobias Novak is an elder Malkavian who believes that achieving collective understanding is the mission of his clan's founder, and they must fulfill it under the influence of the clan's Methuselah known as "Marta."
Toru Asano is a young Asano Hecata assassin and the childe of Sadako Asano.
Trimeggian is an influential and seemingly rational Slavic Malkavian researcher of vitae.

Traska is an eighth generation Tremere and the sire of the enforcer Victor. Residing in Greece as a nobleman, the mortal agent Victor was sent to assassinate him but he Embraced Victor instead. Victor believed his superiors had sent him to Traska for this very purpose.
Turiniel is a Slayer. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as James Scott.

Kindred hear her name and tremble. The Unholy is the oldest vampire most Kindred in Chicago know (or, more accurately, have heard of). She's an independent in the truest sense of the word, in that she doesn't seem to care one whit about who's Prince in what domain. When she comes through the city, she respects no laws but her own and usually leaves a mess to be cleaned up afterward. She quite simply considers herself to be beyond the rules of any so-called Prince younger than she. What's more, the Unholy is an unabashed diablerist, and the stories of her hunts for the heart's blood of Kindred are legion. Just how she has survived so long in clear violation of the Third Tradition without surr
Upala Sengupta is an Ojo Eshu Wilder (barely) and a warrior against the Dauntain.
Urioch is a Defiler in Los Angeles. Urioch is possessing the body of a mortal known as Bobby Jaspers.
Uriminial is a Slayer. She is possessing the body of a mortal known as Selene Diomedes.
The Usurper Radha is a Godling Kuei-jin akuma from Vrindavan.
Ulwazi Mpande is an Ishologu vampire of unknown generation based in Pretoria, South Africa, where he acts as the city's seneschal.
Valgar is a Gangrel of the 6th Generation who follows the Path of the Einherjar.
Valois Sang is a ninth generation Tremere who acts as the Camarilla agent within Montreal.
Lord Varich is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder and founder and High Lord of House Varich.
Valerie Duval is a Ventrue Neonate and Camarilla Scourge of New York City.

The Vampire Queen of Lundenwic, true name unknown, was a leader among the Weihan Cynn who made a pact with a fae being to guard a treasure called the Trophy. In return, the fae influenced the Saxon armies that had been invading at the time. The Queen told no one of the pact and died before she could return the Trophy herself.
Valentina della Passaglia was a faithful Giovanni ghoul of the Della Passaglia family.
Van Hasen is an eighth generation Tremere and the sire of Eleanor Van Hasen. He came from the Netherlands with the first colonists to settle in New York and he eventually Embraced one of the native .
Vaekai are the Reapers who assure the safe passage of family members into the Underworld of Ru's Archipelago.

Václav is a tenth generation Tremere and the childe of Mara. A young apprentice on the Jerusalem chantry, he is forbidden to leave the chantry and spends his time performing rituals on his companion, the experienced gargoyle Rusticus.
Vaclav Petalengro is the Nosferatu Sheriff and Scourge of Vienna in modern nights.

Vasiliy Vasilevich is a seventh generation Ravnos and the sire of Tatiana Stepanova. He taught her little of the Kindred and primarily used her for her talent at burglary. Tatiana deeply resented the Embrace; the thirst for blood violated her sense of humanity on a primal level. It took Tatiana three decades to break free of Vasiliy's hold, after which time she used the few tidbits of information her sire had dropped to wind her way into Kindred society.
Varya Korlov is a member of the Secondary Sources and a Tremere.

Vorus is the Urge Wyrm of Greed. In the 1900s, increased materialism and wealth, particularly in the United States, strengthened it. No Maeljin serves this Urge. Apparently, Vorus either needs no help, or it refuses to share even the least bit of its power with another.

Visya is a sixth generation Tzimisce Voivode, and sire of Radu of Bistritz, Hungary. He used the young diplomat and revenant Radu as ambassador to the west and after he was successful, granted him the Embrace. After that, he used Radu to infiltrate the Council of Ashes, which was originally controlled by Clan Ventrue and its attempt to take power in the East.
Virstania was the Mistress of Gargoyles among clan Tremere. She helped them to revolt.

Bishop Vick is the leader of an apocalyptic vampire faction, the Brotherhood of the Ninth Circle. He was destroyed at the hands of the prince's agent in late 2004. While Vick hates his vampiric nature and wishes to destroy everything, he is very competent in using vampire Disciplines. At some point in the past, Vick was Embraced by an unknown vampire. This Embrace left Vick with trauma and a warped worldview.

Viktor Goga is a Tremere vampire and the leader of The Newcomers, a faction of Kindred active in Seattle circa 2020. He is known as the "Professor". Since arriving in Seattle, he became the main rival of the Baron of Aurora, who views him as a threat. His second-in-command is Elif Parmak. Goga is described as being a charismatic and visionary man, who is willing to offer Cainites safe access to blood in one of Seattle's richest hunting grounds, the University.
Victoria Anne is a Metis Silver Fang Philodox. She appears in Rage.
Volkas Inkfingers is a Bone Shadow Ithaeur member of the Ratcatchers pack in Chicago.
Violet Tremain is a Tzimisce and the former Sabbat Archbishop of New York City.
Vritran is a Luciferan Scourge Minister of the Ministry of Dust for the Blood Court in Los Angeles. Vritran is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jason Kim.
Vugarius, the Stealer of Breaths is a Demonic Spirit and of the Tempter rank. Note: This is a Demon before the Demon: The Fallen game setting.
Verona De Lancey is a mortal woman and Blood doll who lives in Seattle, Washington.
Verdoren, or the Green Man, is an inanimae in charge of the Lost Forest.
Wakshaa, the Essence of Toxin, is an elemental spirit of the Wyrm.
Wanderer is a Skin Dancer masquerading as a Garou who lives in the Cuauhtémoc district, Mexico City.
Wid is a Nosferatu who has claimed domain over the industrial blight that is the city of Wollongong, in the New South Wales region of Australia.
Dr. Winston Brown is an 88-year-old white mage from Lawrence, Kansas. In 1999 he traveled to Iraq with his grad student/apprentice Bryan to uncover an original copy of the Sebel-al-Mafough Whash.
Witchtooths are one of the sub-types of the Ogre seeming. These changelings are hags and twisted witches. Theirs is the blessing of Black Hex.

Wind Over Water is a Black Fury Lupus Theurge. She is the most powerful lupus of the Black Fury tribe living in North America. She has the most knowledge about the Litanty and lupus affairs. And calls upon spirits to determine the fate of Black Fury litters.
Worms of Gluttony (also known as Gourmandlings, Fat-Wrappers, or Fuuru Mur) are spirits associated with consumption, usually of the unhealthy kind.
William Miller was a mentally deranged white supremacist serial killer in life. In death, he became a wraith of the Penitent Legion and arose to the rank of Anacreon in the Atlanta Necropolis.

William Thorbecke was a fifth generation Tremere and the sire of Lille Haake. He was the Regent of the Amsterdam chantry for more than two centuries until he met his final death at the hands of the Sabbat.
Winston Stephens is a Syndicate mage and member of the Cloud Room Construct in Las Vegas.
William Henderson is a Hierarch wraith of the Penitent Legion.

William the Silent was the Anacreon of the Amsterdam Necropolis during the Great War. A member of the Legion of Fate, he was Amsterdam's most respected Anacreon. Just as when he lived as William of Orange, he was well known for turning a blind eye to the less orthodox occurrences within his bailiwick. Rumor has it that he survived the Night of Short Chains and continued to scheme in exile.
Zoë was a young Ravnos vampire prodigy of the Dark Ages and the disciple of Anatole.

depicting Wyrm Slayer.]] Wyrmslayer was a Bronze Age Fianna Garou who forged the first klaive. He is depicted as a modern Ronin in the Rage card game, but this is not supported by the tabletop material.

Zaid Alwan is the leader of a cult that believes in "harvesting" nova's body parts, blood and hormones as one would harvest fruit because they are angels sent by Al'lah for such purpose. Alwan has a grossly overdeveloped muscled physique and his complexion is mottled and unhealthy looking. His unhealthy appearance comes from all of the drugs he has been experimenting over the years (This includes most recently the extremely dangerous drugs which have been derived from novas).

Zlato is a Ravnos that is noted for his inherent ability to suppress any form of magical power. This—and the magic of the Shadow Curtain, as well the power of his sire—saved his life during the Week of Nightmares, making Zlato one of the few still active Ravnos.
Zadkiel ben Aron is one of the most famed Abyss Mystics of his clan. He uses kabbalistic methods to improve his understanding.
Zhenga is a Setite who operates in the criminal underworld of Mombasa.
Yaryan is a vampire of a unique bloodline (formerly a Brujah) who currently resides in Chicago.
Chevalier Yves Mercure is a member of the Sons of Ether, one of the few remaining Ethernauts on Earth in the Final Nights.
Zubaidah Idowu, "The Desert Flower,"is an Ojo Oba and guardian of the Pearl of Dawn Freehold.
Zacchaeus was a Nosferatu information broker from Rome during the Long Night.
Doctor Zachary Tapp is, or was, the founder of Goblin Town and may be the greatest inventor of all the Earthbound Nockers.

Yrtalien, the Forsworn Prince, is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Ailil. In the novel, Court of All Kings, he has completely forgotten himself due to an attack by cold iron. While in the novel, the Cup of Dreams, he has completly regained his memories and is now the Winter King of Hilo, Hawaii.
Yehuda is a Jewish sixth generation Nosferatu of renowned scholarly knowledge.
Zamra Matoub is a 6th generation Lasombra of the Inconnu's Council of Twelve.

Zil is a Ventrue woman of Medieval Vienna, embraced and forced into miserable servitude by the influential Count Orsi. According to Orsi, he saved an enslaved Zil from a harsh master who cut her tongue and removed her ability to speak. She along with her brood mates, Kazi and Teta, continued to serve him up until his death in 1999.
Zerubabel is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Zerubabel is possessing the body of a mortal known as Barry St. James. Spelled as Zerubabel in the name title and as Zerubbabel in the Biography in the book.
Yeshiniel is a Faustian Scrouge. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as Isaac Baker.
Zhang Fuwen is an akuma from Shanghai that serves Mikaboshi.

Yong-Sung is an Anarch vampire of New England. Originally part of the Camarilla, he is recruited into the Anarchs by Saule but is considered treacherous. He killed the sire of the Boston Anarchs leader, Randall Thane.
"Nasty" Buck is a human located in the Golden Flagon in Stormsong Valley. According to Cyrus Crestfall, he never forgets a face.
__NOTOC__ A. F. Kay is a human mage found in a Dragonscale Expedition outpost north of the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.

__NOTOC__ Abatha is a draenei located near Verdant Mire in . As a young girl, she learned the ways of alchemy from her mother, before she passed away. When adventurers of the Alliance find her, she is worried about her missing father and sends them out to find him. Once saved, Abatha is more than happy to join their Lunarfall Garrison and teach them the ways of alchemy.

__NOTOC__ Acolyte Nelesis is a necromancer located in a cave outside the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus. She is the favorite consort of Margrave Sin'dane and one of Kel'Thuzad's favorite acolytes. Balmedar describes her as always acting smug and superior. Balmedar tasks Maw Walkers with killing Nelesis, dragging her corpse back to a ritual circle on the Scaplian Ridge, and performing a ritual to assume her appearance in order to gain entry into the House of Rituals. Her appearance thus becomes the basis for the Illusory Guise.

Adric is an undead human crossbow archer and an old friend of Garrick. While it appears he has gained his independence, he does not seem to be allied to the Forsaken and was able to infect his former friend with the Plague. Wishing Garrick had not come to find him, Adric ends up shooting Garrick in the back when he tries to lead him to his cart to hope that his master could use Adric in able to find a cure for the plague. However, Adric does not want to be cured. Whether these two are still friends living within the unnamed blighted forest is unknown.

Adolphus Blastwidget was a gnome demolitions expert who planted a series of remote-controlled explosives to use against the Horde during their attack on Theramore Isle. When the fighting at Sentry Point began to go badly, Captain Wymor lured as many orcs as possible within range of the hidden explosives planted by Adolphus Blastwidget, and ordered the gnome to detonate them, killing both Wymor and the orcs. Adolphus returned to Theramore Isle to report what happened to Jaina Proudmoore. It is unknown whether or not he was still in the city when the Horde destroyed it with a mana bomb.
Adherent Sun-Callers are arakkoa located in Aruuna in Talador. They summon a Solar Familiar to fight along them.
Adhara White is a human located in Tiragarde Sound. He's a powerful mage who escaped from Tol Dagor.

Aerylia is a prominent val'kyr of the Valarjar who aided the Battlelord during their campaign on the Broken Isles. Within Skyhold, she acts as a transportation guide for warriors using Stormflight, and is able to send individuals to various locations. Outside of this role, she has also acted as an agent of Odyn in the field, traveling on his request with the Battlelord to Helheim in order to recover :Helya's Horn.
Agent Connelly is a retired SI:7 agent and master of disguise. He comes out of retirement, after the player completes Stirred, Not Shaken to help the Alliance in Operation: Shieldwall.
